title: Tiroler Landesmuseum Ferdinandeum
highlights: Traditionsreiches Universalmuseum zur Kunst, Kultur und Naturgeschichte Tirols
Bedeutende Gemaeldegalerie mit Werken von Rembrandt, Brueghel und Lucas Cranach
Einzigartige Sammlungen moderner oesterreichischer Kunst von Egger-Lienz bis heute
Historische Musikinstrumente, darunter weltberuehmte Violinen von Jakob Stainer
kurzbeschreibung: As a universal museum, the Ferdinandeum in Innsbruck spans a fascinating arc from the Stone Age to contemporary art.
beschreibung:
Universal Museum for Art and Science

The Tiroler Landesmuseum Ferdinandeum was founded in 1823 and ranks among the oldest national museums in Central Europe. Representing the collective memory of Tyrol, it charts an impressive journey from prehistory and early history through the Gothic and Baroque eras to contemporary art.

Masterpieces and Historic Rarities

The spacious exhibition galleries showcase outstanding paintings by European masters alongside key works by Tyrolean artists such as Albin Egger-Lienz. The historic collection of musical instruments, featuring priceless stringed instruments crafted by Tyrolean violin maker Jakob Stainer, completes this top-tier museum experience.
